query:
# Every "shares border with" (P47) statement that has a listed exception to
# the symmetric constraint on P47 as its subject or as its value. The
# exception items are read from the constraint statement itself.
#   ?role          whether the exception item is the subject or the value
#   ?reciprocated  whether the reverse direct (best-rank) triple is present
#   ?flagged       whether the query service holds a recorded violation of
#                  the symmetric constraint for this statement
# Recorded violations (wikibase:hasViolationForConstraint) are only present
# for entities whose constraints have been checked, so ?flagged = false does
# not show that the checker accepts the statement. All ranks are included.
PREFIX wd: <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX p: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX ps: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX pq: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/qualifier/>
PREFIX wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX bd: <http://www.bigdata.com/rdf#>

SELECT ?exception ?exceptionLabel ?role ?other ?otherLabel ?rank ?reciprocated ?flagged WHERE {
  wd:P47 p:P2302 ?c .
  ?c ps:P2302 wd:Q21510862 .
  ?c pq:P2303 ?exception .
  {
    ?exception p:P47 ?st .
    ?st ps:P47 ?other .
    BIND("subject" AS ?role)
    BIND(EXISTS { ?other wdt:P47 ?exception } AS ?reciprocated)
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?st ps:P47 ?exception .
    ?other p:P47 ?st .
    BIND("value" AS ?role)
    BIND(EXISTS { ?exception wdt:P47 ?other } AS ?reciprocated)
  }
  ?st wikibase:rank ?rank .
  BIND(EXISTS { ?st wikibase:hasViolationForConstraint ?c } AS ?flagged)
  SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "en" }
}
ORDER BY ?exception ?role ?other
